limitations: A retained link is not evidence of improper influence. Read the original source and any counter-evidence.
alternativeExplanations: India replaced CLND s.17(b) with the recourse model used in the international conventions: operator liability channelled to the operator, supplier recourse only by contract or for deliberate acts. Its stated purpose (Budget 2025) is to bring in private and Indian capital. Foreign-incorporated companies are barred from holding licences. EDF's 2016 request is one of many vendor and industry requests for the convention-standard regime, not evidence that the provision was written for EDF.
